value: Tags an entity as a research paper being tracked in this knowledge base.
Meta-tag collecting all category/topic tags used to classify research papers.
One row per author name credited on a research paper.
The Digital Object Identifier for a research paper.
URL of the archived PDF copy of a research paper, stored at attic.markromanmiller.com.
The journal, conference, or preprint server a research paper was published in or on.
The publication or online-release date of a research paper (ISO 8601).
The abstract text of a research paper.
One row per category/topic tag entity (aComponent=ResearchPaperTag) attached to a research paper.
A 14-item self-report scale measuring sense of presence in a virtual environment, originally developed by Schubert, Friedmann, and Regenbrecht (2001).
A self-report questionnaire measuring VR-induced sickness/discomfort symptoms, adapted from the Simulator Sickness Questionnaire for VR contexts.
The OrderedList giving a research paper's byline order. Its wrappers' theMember values are the paper's own anAuthor statements, by handle.

Multi-valued: points from a construct item (or similar) at a canonical Instrument/Measure entity used to operationalize it (e.g. IPQ, VRSQ). Lets papers sharing the same instrument be found by query instead of string-matching theDescription prose.
The paper's OpenAlex work id (e.g. W7216310588), from which its references and citing works can be looked up. theExplicitAbsence (uuid) when OpenAlex was checked and has no record.
First ECS System item (Fetch paper metadata), theOpenAlexID, and an aToDo for Expand neighbours; agreed with Mark in a Claude Code chat, 2026-10-11.
To represent an ongoing literature review that's meant to stay up to date based upon maintenance (clarification) of questions, not complete revision of them.
Excludes a paper (value) from a review (entity), eg anExclusion of thisReview is thisPaper.
Provides a reason (free text description right now) for why a paper was excluded from the review. It's applied to the statement.
Points from a review (entity) to a work (value) that is not itself a candidate for inclusion but whose references and citations are used to find candidates, e.g. a narrative review.
Includes a paper (value) in a review (entity), eg anInclusion of thisReview is thisPaper.

Tags an entity as one Jev 'noul' question: the exact question sent to a Jev model, carrying everything needed to re-ask it. The tagged entity is itself used as an attribute: `<call> of <paper> is <probability>` records the noul probability (0-1 float) Jev returned when this question was asked about that paper.
The question text passed to Jev as the noul question's `instructions` field, verbatim.
The text passed to Jev as the noul question's `criteria.true` field, verbatim: what counts as a yes.
The text passed to Jev as the noul question's `criteria.false` field, verbatim: what counts as a no.
The model identifier the call was made with, verbatim as sent to the API (e.g. 'typesafe/jev-1.13'), so results from different models are never mixed.

Which part of the paper is given to the model as its input, and in what format -- e.g. title + abstract, or full text. The same question asked of a different part of the paper is a different call, because its answers are not comparable.

Free-text description of how candidate papers are screened for this review: which calls or tools are applied to which part of each paper, how their outputs are combined into a decision, and what gets stored. Singular; a changed process is written as a new statement with aReplacement from the old one.

Marks a paper (value) as a candidate for a review (entity), to be screened by the review's inclusion process, eg aCandidate of thisReview is thisPaper. Multi-valued. Written when a paper is flagged for the review, e.g. Mark tagging a forwarded email as potentially for it. Screening results and anInclusion/anExclusion follow; the candidate statement stays.

A JevNoulCall (value) asked about each candidate of a review (entity) during screening, eg aScreeningCall of thisReview is thisCall. Multi-valued. The Screen candidates System asks every one of them and stores each answer as '<call> of <paper> is <probability>'.
Tags a ResearchPaper whose anAuthor statements name only some of its authors (for example, only those at the schools a search covers). The full byline can be fetched from theOpenAlexID or theDOI.
Placed on an anAuthor statement: an AcademicInstitution the author was listed with on that paper. One statement per institution. Describes the paper, not where the person is now.
Placed on an anAuthor statement: the author's place in the paper's byline, as 'N of M' (e.g. '5 of 5' for the last of five authors).
Placed on an anAuthor statement: the Person who is credited under that name.
IncompleteAuthorList, theAffiliation, theBylinePosition and theAuthorPerson; agreed with Mark in a Claude Code chat, 2026-10-22.
